note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do; the .sav variable labels (I5901. Salir en la noche ... I5914. Otro) tie all 14 codes to form q.5.9 options 01-14. Words from the official Spanish questionnaire, verbatim (label I50903 reads y amigos, form reads o amigos; form ships). Option Si=1/No=0 per the do-file recode of form codes 1/2 (7/8/9 dropped), confirmed by live per-item resp counts matching the .sav Si/No counts in 28/28 cells. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of the Spanish INEC questionnaire, and item I50914 is the form write-in "Otro ?" (Especifique) catch-all, so its yes responses cover whatever other activity each respondent named.
